mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO drops > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth slows below 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 2% and UNRATE > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth slows below 1% year-over-year and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a supply-demand imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth < 1% and GDPC1 QoQ growth < 2%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < 1% and GDPC1 QoQ < 2%.
